tha-ap310:1.1: Anulepadāyaka.] Atthadassissa munino addasaṃ sāvakam ahaṃ / navakammaṃ karontassa *sīmāya upagacch' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap310:2.1: Niṭṭhite navakamme *ca anulepaṃ adās' ahaṃ / pasannacitto sumano puññakkhette anuttare. // //
tha-ap310:3.1: Atthārase kappasate yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi anulepass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap310:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Anulepadāyako thero i. g. a-ti.
